_note: Written by hand: a task plan for the hand-written PRD of fixtures/llm/prd.json, whose requirements get the ids req_001 to req_004. T4 is listed before the task it depends on, to show that the build order follows dependencies.

epics.title: Reliable payments
epics.description: A payment always ends in a state the user can see.

tasks.title: Set up the project and the data model
tasks.description: Create the app skeleton with groups, members, expenses and payments. Done when a group with one expense can be saved and read back.

tasks.title: Refund failed payments automatically
tasks.description: When the payment provider reports a failure after a debit, start the refund without the user asking. Done when a failed test payment is refunded and shown as refunded.

tasks.title: Track the state of every payment
tasks.description: Record each payment as pending, completed, failed or refunded, and show the state in the group. Done when every payment shows exactly one final state.

tasks.title: Keep ads out of the payment flow
tasks.description: Make sure no full-screen ad can be shown between starting and finishing a payment. Done when the payment screens never request an ad.

epics.title: Getting in and settling up
epics.description: Users can always log in and settle a group quickly.

tasks.title: Add a second way to log in
tasks.description: Offer login by email link when the verification code does not arrive. Done when a user with no code can log in by the link.

tasks.title: Settle a group in one tap
tasks.description: Work out the fewest payments that clear a group and let a member pay their share in one tap. Done when a three-person group is settled with the minimum number of payments.
